attributes.protocol: Runs N’ Poses receptor–ligand co-folding; source benchmark 2,600 systems. Figure 2C reports n=2,573 scored ligands on the intersection where all models produced valid predictions, after excluding undefined SuCOS scores. attributes.protocol: Taxonomy: 13,209 glycans total across eight levels, 4–1,737 classes per level. Official fixed GlycanML motif-based train/validation/test splits (8:1:1). Section 2.5 reports class-balanced classifiers, train ∪ validation hyperparameter selection by randomized search with 3-fold cross-validation, followed by one evaluation on the held-out test set; complete procedure repeated with three random seeds, reporting mean and standard deviation. GlycanGT large model pretrained with 35% masking provides [Graph] embeddings to SVM/LightGBM; the selected classifier for each S4 row is not identified. Section 2.6 states that all four graph baselines were trained and evaluated on the same datasets/splits; it does not establish that each baseline used the GlycanGT downstream classifier search. SVM search: 10 iterations, RBF/linear, C logU(1e-3,1e2), gamma logU(1e-4,1e-1); LightGBM: 15 randomized iterations. Do not combine with separate original GlycanML-paper protocols.

name: VEST4: points-scale PP3/BP4 score intervals (Bergquist et al. 2025)
description: Published calibration; transcribed, not reproduced.

comparison.population: 11,834 missense variants from 1,914 genes; prior probability of pathogenicity 4.41% (gnomAD set)
comparison.inputs: Precomputed or author-generated scores of the tool for each variant
comparison.adaptation: None; thresholds fitted to the tool's scores
comparison.metric_implementation: Local posterior probability of pathogenicity estimated in a sliding score window on the ClinVar 2019 set with prior 0.0441; a threshold is the most lenient score at which the one-sided 95% bootstrap bound (10,000 iterations) of the local positive likelihood ratio still reaches the cut-off for that strength (2.406, 5.790, 33.53, 1,124; reciprocals for BP4)
comparison.aggregation: Pooled over variants in all genes

comparison.budget.note: Calibration of precomputed scores; no compute budget
